resources.string: Use this phone\'s desktop mode on its own screen, or from a computer.
Only one desktop can run at a time. Starting a session closes the one on this phone, and its windows go back to the phone.
The desktop needs Shizuku. Start it in the Shizuku app, then try again.
A session for a computer is running. End it first.
Desktop closed, because a session for a computer started or its helper stopped.
Android did not make this a desktop. Try turning on Enable desktop experience features in Developer options, then reboot.
Session running. Connect from your computer with the details below.

Shinonome needs Shizuku permission for this.
Unlock the phone once to start. Its screen then turns off, and the session keeps running if it locks. Whoever has the pairing code can use your apps until the session ends.
